reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): the `sql` and `quote_table_name` set rows this replaces were converged — the body now calls `Arel.sql(...)` and `connectionFor(model).quoteTableName(...)` where query_methods.rb:1986 does. The residual inversion is Rails' FIRST `Arel.sql` (`self.references_values |= [Arel.sql(table_name, retryable: true)]`, query_methods.rb:1979), which trails cannot emit: `_referencesValues` stores bare strings, and only auto-derived SqlLiteral references seed JoinDependency's alias map. Converging that store is its own change; every call Rails makes in this body is made here.

Satisfied in `Relation#whereAssociated`, which is where Rails' `associations.each` body lives in this port: the already-joined guard (`query_methods.rb:91`) reads `joinsValues` / `leftOuterJoinsValues` and `includes` there, per-iteration, exactly as Rails does. Same split as the existing `joins!` / `not` entries for this method.
